author: cairn
blurb: Get public holidays for any country and year. No API key needed.

definition.name: Public Holidays
definition.description: Look up official public holidays for a country and year via the Nager.Date API.

operations.name: get_public_holidays
operations.description: List public holidays for a given year and country code.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"get_public_holidays","description":"Get public holidays for a year and ISO country code.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"year":{"type":"number","description":"Four-digit year, e.g. 2026"},"countryCode":{"type":"string","description":"ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'ZA'"}},"required":["year","countryCode"]}}

operations.name: get_next_public_holidays
operations.description: List upcoming public holidays for a country over the next 365 days.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"get_next_public_holidays","description":"Get upcoming public holidays for an ISO country code.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"countryCode":{"type":"string","description":"ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'US'"}},"required":["countryCode"]}}
